leadHtml:
EMBED V0.27.0 COMPLETE

@fzlt/core/embed

Drop a game onto any page with one small config. palette - hex colours for the Board UI roles (anything else is ignored: no CSS injection) easterEgg - false: open now. true / {...}: stay dormant (tiny listeners only) until a trigger (key sequence, gesture on a selector, click on a selector), then lazy-load the game. toggle - a floating key to reopen / close once unlocked. Escape closes and restores the page. Lifted from Swarm Protocol's loader: keys typed in fields never count, only a position and a timestamp are kept for the sequence (never the typed text), and destroy() removes everything.

EasterEgg interface COMPLETE

What wakes a dormant embed: a key sequence ("konami" or your own keys), a gesture or a click on a selector, each limited to desktop, mobile or all; toggle adds the on-page toggle key.

export interface EasterEgg {
    sequence?: "konami" | string[] | false;
    gesture?: {
        on: string;
        type: "hold-tap" | "double-tap" | "long-press";
    } | false;
    click?: string | false;
    scope?: {
        sequence?: Scope;
        gesture?: Scope;
        click?: Scope;
    };
    toggle?: boolean;
}

EmbedConfig interface COMPLETE

The one config an embed takes: its name, the toggle label, the Board UI palette and the easter egg.

export interface EmbedConfig {
    /** Short id: data-<name>-trigger / data-<name>-ignore, the toggle label. */
    name: string;
    /** Label on the toggle key (default: name). */
    label?: string;
    palette?: Palette;
    easterEgg?: boolean | EasterEgg;
    /** With no easter egg: open right away (default) or wait closed behind the toggle key. */
    open?: boolean;
}

Mounted interface COMPLETE

A mounted game: destroy() removes it and gives the page back.

export interface Mounted {
    destroy(): void;
}

Mount type COMPLETE

Your game's mount function: draws the game into host and returns it as Mounted.

export type Mount = (host: HTMLElement, config: EmbedConfig) => Mounted;

embed function COMPLETE

Drop a game onto the page: load is called (and awaited) only when the game opens, at once or when the easter egg fires. Returns the controls: open(), close(), unlock(), opened, unlocked and destroy().
